We need to determine charges based on facts. Primary charge likely 受贿 (bribery). Companion charges list: 滥用职权 (abuse of power) co-occurred 3x. Need include if facts support it.

Let's analyze facts:

- Defendant Luo1 (罗1某) is former driver of Mo2 (莫某2) former director of land resources bureau. He used influence to get project, bribed officials, etc.

Charges present:

1. He accepted bribes: 300 million? Actually 300万 from partners for project, plus 250万 from other, plus 200万 from mining, plus 35万 from official (but that is bribe given to official, i.e., 行贿). Also he gave 100万 to official (贿赂). So he both received bribes (受贿) and gave bribes (行贿). Also he was involved in unit bribery (单位行贿) maybe because he gave bribe on behalf of macro company? The 35万 given to former bureau chief 曾某 as representative of macro company: that's unit bribery (单位行贿) because he acted as representative of macro company. Also earlier 100万 given to official via subordinate: that's 行贿 (personal). Also 300万 from partners is bribe received (受贿). Also 250万 from Mo2 via service agreement: also 受贿.

Thus charges: 受贿, 行贿, 单位行贿.

Now滥用职权: Did he abuse power? He is not a state functionary at time of acts? He was former driver, later maybe still had influence but not official. He used influence of Mo2 (who is official) to get project. He may have abused his position? He was not a public official when he accepted bribes. However he may have abused his position as former driver? Not typical. The charge 滥用职权 applies to state functionaries who abuse authority. He is not a state functionary at time of acts (maybe after resignation). So likely not.

But there is also "受贿" primary. Companion charge list only includes 滥用职权 (co-occurred 3x). We include only if facts support it. I think not.

Thus final answer: 受贿;行贿;单位行贿
